title: Understanding the Matrix Columns
text: The vectors $u_1$ and $u_2$ are columns of the matrix $U$ from the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD). Each column in $U$ is an orthonormal vector.

title: Orthonormal Vectors
text: Orthonormal vectors are vectors that are both orthogonal (perpendicular) to each other and have a unit length (magnitude of 1).

title: Checking Validity
text: To determine if the combination of $u_1$ and $u_2$ is valid, check if they are orthonormal. This means checking if their dot product is zero and if each vector has a magnitude of $$1$$.

title: Dot Product of $u_1$ and $u_2$
text: Calculate the dot product of $u_1$ and $u_2$. If the dot product is zero, they are orthogonal.

title: Magnitude of $u_1$ and $u_2$
text: Calculate the magnitude of $u_1$ and $u_2$. If both have a magnitude of $$1$$, they are unit vectors.

title: Conclusion on Validity
text: If $u_1$ and $u_2$ are orthonormal, then the combination of values is valid. Otherwise, it is not.
